record.paper_title: Some open questions and conjectures about visibility and iteration in bounded convex domains in ℂ^N
record.original_question: Let N ≥ 1 and let F: 𝔻^N → 𝔻^N be a holomorphic self-map of the unit polydisc with no fixed point in 𝔻^N. Must there always exist a coordinate index j ∈ {1,…,N} and a boundary point σ ∈ ∂𝔻 such that, for every initial point z ∈ 𝔻^N, the j-th coordinate of the orbit converges to σ; that is, lim_{n→∞} π_j(F^{∘n}(z)) = σ for all z ∈ 𝔻^N?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5.1. Let N ≥ 1 and let F : D^N → D^N be holomorphic and without fixed points. Then there exist j ∈ {1, . . . , N} and σ ∈ ∂D such that limn→∞ πj(F◦n(z)) = σ for all z ∈ D^N, where πj(z) = zj (the projection on the j-th component).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N\geq 1$ and let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc, with $\mathbb{D}^N$ the unit polydisc in $\mathbb{C}^N$ and $\partial\mathbb{D}$ the unit circle. For $j\in\{1,\dots,N\}$ let $\pi_j:\mathbb{C}^N\to\mathbb{C}$ be the projection $\pi_j(z_1,\dots,z_N)=z_j$. Given a holomorphic self-map $F:\mathbb{D}^N\to\mathbb{D}^N$, denote by $F^{\circ n}$ its $n$-fold composition.

Suppose $F:\mathbb{D}^N\to\mathbb{D}^N$ is holomorphic and has no fixed point in $\mathbb{D}^N$. Decide whether there must always exist an index $j\in\{1,\dots,N\}$ and a point $\sigma\in\partial\mathbb{D}$ such that
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\pi_j\bigl(F^{\circ n}(z)\bigr)=\sigma\qquad\text{for every }z\in\mathbb{D}^N.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a conjecture about Denjoy–Wolff-type behavior on the polydisc: for every fixed-point-free holomorphic self-map of $\mathbb{D}^N$, some coordinate of every orbit converges to a single boundary point of the disc. Searches reveal active work on Denjoy–Wolff theorems for bounded symmetric domains and partial results on orbit limit sets in polydiscs, but no source confirming a full proof or counterexample of this specific statement was found. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A Denjoy–Wolff theorem for bounded symmetric domains
status_evidence.snippet: A Denjoy–Wolff theorem is proved for fixed-point free compact holomorphic maps on finite-rank bounded symmetric domains; the main obstacle is identifying which boundary components contain orbit limit points.
status_evidence.claim: Denjoy–Wolff-type results in several variables remain delicate and partial, with the polydisc case requiring extra information about the map.

status_evidence.title: Fixed points and dynamics of holomorphic maps (Reppekus)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of fixed-point and orbit-convergence results for holomorphic self-maps in several complex variables.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of the stated polydisc coordinate-convergence conjecture is reported in current surveys.
